title: Reports (grey literature)
covers: Reports, working papers, policy documents and theses not written as journal studies. A report with its own data or model is also rated under that design's profile, and the lower grade stands.

adapted_from.name: AACODS: Authority, Accuracy, Coverage, Objectivity, Date, Significance (Tyndall 2010)

questions.text: Authority: are the issuing organisation and the authors identified, with relevant expertise?
Objectivity: are funding, sponsors and the issuer's interests stated, and are the conclusions free of advocacy that shapes them?
Was it reviewed: peer review, external review, a thesis committee or an advisory group?
Accuracy: are the data and sources behind its figures cited or described?
Coverage: are its scope, limits and exclusions stated?
Date: are the dates of its data stated, with cost or performance figures no more than about five years older than the report?
Significance: does it relate its findings to other studies or evidence?
